title: Phone Bhoot
desc: Inspired by stories from their childhood, two young men create a business around capturing ghosts. However, their endeavour turns dangerous when they must fulfil their promise to a poltergeist.

title: KUMKI 2
desc: Bhoomi rescues a baby elephant and nurtures it before the animal unexpectedly disappears. Five years later, he returns from college and ventures into the forest to find his old companion.

title: Rishtey - A Grand Celebration
desc: After falling in love with each other, a man and a woman must overcome obstacles and the generation-long rift between their families.

title: Double Dhamaal
desc: Four idlers make elaborate plans to earn money by investing in buildings but are conned by Kabir, who leaves them unemployed and penniless. Soon, they are on the prowl to avenge their humiliation.

title: Dabangg 3
desc: Chulbul Pandey, a corrupt police officer, leads a happy life with his wife and family. However, when his past enemy returns to wreak havoc, he must protect his loved ones from harm.

title: Snake Island Python
desc: A group of explorers set out to search for a magical tree in the jungle and soon find a mysterious creature is waiting to attack them.
